title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next NVFP4 QAD on four Sparks with persistent prefix caching
evidence_scope: Bounded QAD TP4/DCP1 text cold/warm reuse, four-rank disk restore through fresh processes, corrupted-object rejection with full recomputation, and original-service rollback. No media, full-context, concurrent, performance or long-duration qualification.
